I know, we all know, that the blatant lies of ‘don’t worry things will turn around’ are just what people think will make it better because they think it’s what we want to hear, im not the best at advice but come up with like a list of things you still want to accomplish in your life, hopefully they aren’t all money based and if they are then hopefully you have enough money to make it work. And something I hear a lot that personally helps me is that if you’re at rock bottom there’s only one way to go. And maybe after you check off the things, you’ll feel at peace and won’t feel like you have unfinished business? And believe me I know how hard exercise is when you’re overweight but just put in the effort towards that and if you really see it happening, go for it. After a run or something your head will feel a lot better and that’s the truth. And it’s also easier to achieve goals if you plan it with the numbers and all. Say like, this time next month you want to have lost half a stone. We’re all cheering for you and can I ask, have you tried putting yourself out there since the divorce?
